|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per game target a system. At related sites, "nighttime conditions" are in effect and spies deploy - 2. You may not play Dark Hours. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Sunsdown (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Dark Hours is canceled. Once per game, may target a system. At related sites, ‘nighttime conditions’ are in effect and spies are deploy -2. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' added “Dark Hours is canceled.”; “game” → “game, may”; “"nighttime conditions"” → “‘nighttime conditions’”; added “are”; “- 2. You may not play Dark Hours.” → “-2.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 46.
